definition_quote.value: The practice of optometry includes: examination of the human eye to ascertain the presence of defects or abnormal conditions that may be corrected or relieved by the use of lenses, prisms or ocular exercises, or visual training or orthoptics and the prescribing or adapting of lenses, prisms or ocular exercises, or visual training or orthoptics for the correction, relief, remediation, or prevention of such conditions; employment of any subjective or objective mechanism to determine the accommodative or refractive states of the human eye; use of testing appliances for the purpose of the measurement of the powers of vision; examination, diagnosis, and optometric treatment of conditions and visual or muscular anomalies of the human eye; evaluation, examination, diagnosis, and treatment of abnormal or diseased conditions of the human eye and its adnexa; preoperative and postoperative care related to the human eye and adnexa; and use of diagnostic pharmaceutical agents.
definition_quote.quote: The practice of optometry includes: 1. Examination of the human eye to ascertain the presence of defects or abnormal conditions that may be corrected or relieved by the use of lenses, prisms or ocular exercises, or visual training or orthoptics
